_help: Copy to <run>/04-pool/candidates.json. The agent writes JUDGMENT only. build_pool.py adds every number. Delete this key.

<key>.name: <service name as the client says it>

items.topic: Hero headline with city and district
items.cover_note: Share of local sites with the district in title, heading or URL

items.fit_reason: Service is on the live site.

_fields.fit: 0 not offered (cut), 1 adjacent (client confirms), 2 education around a real service, 3 exact service
_fields.effort: 1 text only, 2 needs client facts or images, 3 new page or third party
_fields.demand_mode: optional: expectation for blocks visitors expect (proof, location, first visit)
_fields.page_tag: homepage | service:<slug> | place:<slug> | authority-page | blog-faq | offsite | later | cut
_fields.client_signal_text: optional free text when the data is not in a file
